title: INVOIS 2026.js: Malware Targeting Japanese Users
content_md:
Today we will take time to analyze the malware INVOIS 2026.js, which targets Japanese users under the title "ご教示ください". The malware is delivered in a compressed file; when the user extracts it and runs the JavaScript, it infects the system with malware...

Article Link: Malware targeting Japanese people under the title "ご教示ください" - INVOIS 2026.js
